_doc: research-lineage automation config. Put it in the project root as research-lineage.json; paths are relative to it. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Guide: references/automation.md
title: RAG 幻觉评测：研究脉络

crawl._queries_doc: arXiv search_query syntax (all:, ti:, abs:, AND/OR, quoted phrases); OpenAlex title_and_abstract.search syntax (AND/OR/NOT, quoted phrases)
arxiv_queries: all:"retrieval-augmented" AND all:hallucination AND (all:benchmark OR all:evaluation OR all:detection)
all:RAG AND all:faithfulness AND (all:metric OR all:benchmark)
openalex_queries: ("retrieval-augmented generation" OR RAG) AND hallucination AND (benchmark OR evaluation OR detection)
crawl._anchors_doc: arXiv IDs of core papers: new papers citing them are candidates. anchor_titles: core papers without an arXiv ID (resolved in OpenAlex by exact title)

scoring._doc: regexes are matched against lowercased title / title+abstract; see the Rules docstring in automation/crawl.py

crawl._auto_ingest_doc: optional: candidates passing these strict title rules skip the inbox and go straight into a category (reviewed weekly). Set to null to send everything to the inbox.
